title: Qutrit Clifford+T gates by two-body angular momentum couplings, rotations and one-axis-twistings
summary: We develop an angular momentum representation and implementation of the Clifford+T set of unitaries for qutrits. We show that local gates from this set can be realized by the sole use of suitable rotations and one-axis-twisting operations, which are at most quadratic in the angular momentum operators and thus can be experimentally realized in many quantum systems.
